name: 適用範囲を説明する言語と利用場所の設定
prompt:
Input roles: Image 1: authoritative Japanese mock: exact panel layout and spacing. Image 2: edit target: registered generated v001. Image 3: original crop: card proportions, inset and chevron geometry. Image 4: approved visual direction.
Use case: ui-mockup. Refine LH07-0109. The Japanese mock is the exact layout, spacing, scale and content target. Image 2 is only the current generated edit target. Image 3 controls card construction and chevron geometry. Keep the two existing cards only; no extra content.
At 390x284, match the mock landmarks: heading 1 at x=16,y=20; card 1 at x=16,y=62,w=358,h=70; heading 2 at x=16,y=173; card 2 at x=16,y=214,w=358,h=70, ending flush at y=284. Inside each card keep 14px left inset, bold value followed by one muted single-line helper, and a small right chevron aligned to the right. Compared with v001, move heading 1 up about 15px; set both card margins to 16px; move card 1 up about 6px and add 3px height; move heading 2 down about 2px; move card 2 down about 11px and add 2px height to meet the canvas bottom. Use the exact text scale from the preview and exact Japanese strings. The exact strings are: 言語; 英語（米国）; このアプリで使用する主な言語です。; 国・地域; 米国; このアプリを利用する国・地域です。 Use white canvas, very light neutral card fills, dark slate text, muted slate helper and chevrons; restrained card corners. No action gradient, shadow-heavy treatment, phone chrome, extra spaces or line breaks.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
